Liam - great, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and what we'll send over by EOD: 

PO vs Card vs Marketplace
- Pilot: easiest is Hosted (Redwood API) on card for immediate start. If Procurement requires a PO for the pilot, we can accept a PO and route for Net terms - we just need the PO template and approver list.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is an option but it usually adds 3-4 weeks to procurement and requires us to create a listing. If speed is critical, card or direct PO is faster.

Deployment & commercial path
- Hosted (on-demand): lowest friction, usage-based billing, good for short pilots.
- Hosted with commit: card or PO for pilot, with a committed spend gives material discounts (we can show 10-25% depending on commit size).
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): recommended if you expect steady high throughput (SLA-backed). Reserved pools start at roughly $20k/month and scale with GPU/throughput. Commitment terms typically 6-12 months.
- Private (on-prem/VPC): for regulated workloads - enterprise contract, longer procurement and deployment cadence; includes additional compliance attachments and dedicated onboarding.

Action items from us (EOD): 
- Commercial options: 2-pager showing pilot hosted (card + PO path) and a 12-month Dedicated commit option.
- SOC2 & security docs: SOC2 attestation + report link.

I'll attach a short commit options workbook and a simple comparison slide. If Procurement can share the PO template, Aditya or I will draft a PO-ready commercial term sheet.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood-Commit-Options.xlsx (pricing breakouts)

Subject: Commercial path & commit options (short)

Hi Liam / Jenna -

Following Marissa's note - quick commercial framing to help procurement decide: 

Option A - Pilot (low friction)
- Hosted API, on-demand billing (card preferred) or one-off PO for the pilot amount.
- No infra commitments; scale to production when you're happy with quality.

Option B - Production (cost predictability)
- Dedicated reserved capacity with monthly commit (6 or 12 months).
- Typical entry point: $20k/month reserve (~baseline throughput for moderate qps) with stepped pricing as you scale.

Option C - Regulated/Enterprise
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with enterprise license + onboarding professional services.

Discounting & terms
- We can offer incremental discounts for 12-month commits and larger ARR.
- Net-30/Net-60 are negotiable (we've accommodated Net-60 for strategic customers).

Please send your PO template and any preferred contract language items (e.g., data residency, indemnity). We'll generate a PO-ready commercial term sheet for your legal review.

Thanks - attaching the commit options workbook for numbers.

- Aditya
